lastCheck.description: Time of the last check, or `null` when never checked.

status.description: Result of the last check: `success`, `unreachable`, `error`, or `unknown`.

lastSuccess.description: Time of the last successful check, or `null`.

registeredAccountUid.description: Account uid registered in the domain's site config, or `null` when unknown.

peerId.description: Peer id of the node serving the domain, or `null` when unknown.

isGateway.description: Whether the domain is a public gateway that serves canonical `/hm/*` URLs.

lastError.description: Error details from the last failed check, or `null`.

description: The daemon's view of a site domain: registration, gateway status, and health-check results.
